mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chem_info(code, name, alias, cas_no, category, compat_group, compat_group2, spec, unit, stock_qty, min_stock, max_once, cabinet_id, expiry_warn_days, ghz_pictogram, first_aid, status) VALUES(#{code}, #{name}, #{alias}, #{casNo}, #{category}, #{compatGroup}, #{compatGroup2}, #{spec}, #{unit}, #{stockQty}, #{minStock}, #{maxOnce}, #{cabinetId}, #{expiryWarnDays}, #{ghzPictogram}, #{firstAid}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chem_info WHERE cas_no = #{casNo} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE chem_info SET name = #{name}, alias = #{alias}, spec = #{spec}, unit = #{unit}, min_stock = #{minStock}, max_once = #{maxOnce}, cabinet_id = #{cabinetId}, expiry_warn_days = #{expiryWarnDays}, ghz_pictogram = #{ghzPictogram}, first_aid = #{firstAid}, compat_group = #{compatGroup}, compat_group2 = #{compatGroup2}, status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE chem_info SET deleted = 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE chem_info SET status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chem_batch(chemical_id, stock_in_id, lot_no, qty_in, qty_left, expiry_date, cabinet_id, status) VALUES(#{chemicalId}, #{stockInId}, #{lotNo}, #{qtyIn}, #{qtyLeft}, #{expiryDate}, #{cabinetId}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chem_batch WHERE chemical_id = #{chemicalId} AND status = 0 AND qty_left > 0 ORDER BY expiry_date ASC, lot_no ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE chem_batch SET qty_left = qty_left - #{qty}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0 AND qty_left >= #{qty}
UPDATE chem_batch SET qty_left = qty_left + #{qty}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE chem_batch SET status = #{to}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{from}
UPDATE chem_batch SET cabinet_id = #{cabinetId}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND cabinet_id = #{fromCabinetId} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ci.* FROM chem_batch b JOIN chem_info ci ON b.chemical_id = ci.id WHERE b.cabinet_id = #{cabinetId} AND b.status = 0 AND ci.status = 0 AND ci.deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty_left), 0) FROM chem_batch WHERE chemical_id = #{chemicalId} AND status = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE chem_batch SET qty_left = 0, status = 2, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 3
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chem_info WHERE code LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chem_batch WHERE chemical_id = #{chemicalId} AND status = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chem_batch b JOIN chem_info ci ON b.chemical_id = ci.id WHERE b.status = 0 AND b.qty_left > 0 AND b.expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND ci.deleted = 0 AND DATEDIFF('DAY', CURRENT_DATE, b.expiry_date) <= COALESCE(ci.expiry_warn_days, 30)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chem_info WHERE deleted = 0 AND min_stock > 0 AND stock_qty < min_stock

SELECT category AS "category", COUNT(*) AS "chem_count", COALESCE(SUM(stock_qty), 0) AS "total_stock", GROUP_CONCAT(name ORDER BY id SEPARATOR '、') AS "chem_names" FROM chem_info WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
SELECT status AS "status", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM chem_batch GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
